snippet.title: State of Decay 3 Official Gameplay Reveal | XBOX Games Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Community is Survival

The zombie apocalypse nearly wiped out humankind. Years after the initial outbreak, carve out a life for yourself in a world gripped by blood plague. Play as a community of survivors, build up your settlements with friends, and destroy zombies in State of Decay 3, the latest in the franchise from developer Undead Labs.

COMING IN 2027. Wishlist now: https://www.xbox.com/games/state-of-decay-3

State of Decay 3 is coming to XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC as an XBOX Play Anywhere title and with XBOX Game Pass.
